safety_precautions: use gloves when handling wood and glue
ensure workspace is clear of hazards

steps.description: Measure the dimensions of the left armrest to create a matching right armrest.
Cut the wood to the measured dimensions for the new armrest.
Sand the edges of the cut wood to ensure a smooth finish.
Attach the new armrest to the chair using wood glue and screws.
Clamp the armrest in place and allow the glue to dry according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Finish the armrest with stain or paint to match the rest of the chair.

tips: Ensure the new armrest is securely attached before removing clamps.
Choose a finish that matches the existing furniture for a seamless look.
